preconditions: A 128-byte allocation mapped at guest 0x02000000; input pointer offsets refer to this shared allocation. Private valid stack, DF clear, normal return only; no calls/globals/relocations or stack writes. Nonvolatile registers must be preserved; flags and other volatile registers are unobserved. All 128 bytes are observed after return, including untouched bytes. Stack arguments are allocation base + base, index, enabled in that order. base + 4*(index>>5) + 4 must be at most 128 without wrapping. Only that four-byte word may be read or written. All 32 bits of index/enabled are supplied. Return observes all EAX bits; callee pops twelve argument bytes.
